en.why.title: Why ELRS Mobile?
en.why.subtitle: Real-world solutions for the field and the bench.
en.why.problem_desc: You're at a remote bando and realize your TX is on v4.0 but your RX is on v3.3. No cell service, no laptop, and no way to reach the Web Flasher.
en.why.problem_fix_desc: Open the app, select your cached target, and flash via Wi-Fi. Back in the air in under 60 seconds—zero bars required.
en.why.updates_desc: Changed your home Wi-Fi password or SSID? Bringing ten aircraft to your PC just to update a text string is a massive chore.
en.why.updates_fix_desc: Bring your phone to the fleet. Connect to each quad's AP and update network settings or binding phrases natively and instantly.

en.how.title: How it works
en.how.subtitle: Download once at home. Flash anywhere, no signal needed.
en.how.step1_body: Open the Firmware Manager while you have internet and download the ExpressLRS versions you use. They're saved on your phone for offline flashing.
en.how.step2_body: Power on your receiver or transmitter and wait for its Wi-Fi hotspot, then join the ExpressLRS RX or TX network. The app finds the device automatically.
en.how.step3_body: Choose your target and flashing profile, then tap Flash. The app builds the firmware with your binding phrase and Wi-Fi settings and uploads it over Wi-Fi.
en.features.title: Everything you need at the field
en.features.subtitle: One app for flashing, configuring, and managing your ExpressLRS hardware.
en.features.flash_body: Pick device type, vendor, frequency, and target from guided menus. Your binding phrase, Wi-Fi, and regulatory domain are patched in before upload, and a target check warns you before you flash the wrong firmware.
en.features.cache_body: Download ExpressLRS releases ahead of time and see which are ready for offline use. Choose how many versions to keep and how much storage they take.
en.features.profiles_body: Save binding phrases, home Wi-Fi credentials, and regulatory domains once. Named flashing profiles let you switch between aircraft and radios in one tap.
en.features.config_body: Open your device's built-in configuration pages inside the app to check its firmware, change settings, and map PWM outputs.
en.hardware.unsupported: Not supported: STM32-based hardware (no Wi-Fi flashing), Betaflight passthrough, and USB or serial flashing.
en.videos.bardwell_desc: A comprehensive review showing offline firmware flashing.
en.videos.painless_desc: A step-by-step walkthrough of the app and offline bench configuration.
en.hardware.list_intro: Every device below is an ESP-based ExpressLRS receiver or transmitter that ELRS Mobile can flash over Wi-Fi. Devices marked Verified have been flashed successfully by ELRS Mobile users. This list is generated from the official ExpressLRS hardware targets.
en.privacy.intro: ELRS Mobile ("the App") is an independent, open-source app for flashing and configuring ExpressLRS hardware. It has no accounts and no servers of its own that store your data. This policy explains what stays on your phone, what the App sends to third-party services, and how to turn optional data sharing off.
en.privacy.local_profiles_desc: binding phrases, home Wi-Fi network names and passwords, regulatory domains and Wi-Fi auto-on intervals. These are kept in your phone's encrypted secure storage.
en.privacy.local_prefs_desc: language, firmware cache limit, Expert Mode, your analytics choice, a manually entered device IP address, and update-check timestamps.
en.privacy.local_cache_desc: ExpressLRS firmware and hardware files you download for offline use.
en.privacy.local_note: The App never sends this data to us or to third parties. When you flash a device, your binding phrase (as a derived ID) and Wi-Fi network and password are written into the firmware and sent directly to your own ExpressLRS device over its local Wi-Fi connection.
en.privacy.analytics_desc: Usage analytics are on by default. The App uses Aptabase, a privacy-focused analytics service, to count how it is used so development can focus on what matters. It sends anonymous events when firmware is downloaded or flashed (with the hardware target and firmware version), when a download or flash fails (with the error type and message), and when the device configuration page is opened.
en.privacy.analytics_never: Analytics never include your binding phrase, Wi-Fi network names or passwords, your name, or other personal information.
en.privacy.analytics_optout: You can turn usage analytics off at any time in Settings → App & Storage → Share Analytics. The App then sends no further analytics events.
en.privacy.crash_desc: To find and fix bugs, the App uses Sentry. When the App crashes or hits an unexpected error, it may send a report containing your phone model, operating system version, App version, technical details of the error, and recent App log messages. Log messages can include the local IP address of your ExpressLRS device but never your binding phrase or Wi-Fi passwords. Only a sample of errors is sent, and routine connection drops are filtered out.
en.privacy.crash_toggle: Crash reporting is separate from usage analytics and is not affected by the Share Analytics setting.
en.privacy.crash_debug: If you choose to send a debug report (Settings → Advanced & Debug, with Expert Mode on), it includes the description you type, your App version, Expert Mode and default regulatory domain settings, whether a home Wi-Fi network is set, and recent App logs. It never includes your binding phrase or Wi-Fi passwords.
en.privacy.network_desc: To work, the App connects to the following services. Like any web server, they may log your IP address under their own privacy policies.
en.privacy.network_firmware: ExpressLRS firmware server (artifactory.expresslrs.org) and GitHub, when you download firmware or the App refreshes its list of supported hardware.
en.privacy.network_updates: cdn.elrsmobile.com (served through Cloudflare), at most once a day, to check for updates. This applies only to the APK downloaded directly from this website or GitHub; store versions are updated by Google Play and the App Store.
en.privacy.network_device: Your own ExpressLRS device, over its local Wi-Fi, to identify it, flash it, and show its configuration page.
en.privacy.perm_network_desc: to find your ExpressLRS device and keep talking to it over a Wi-Fi network that has no internet connection, and to download firmware.
en.privacy.perm_local_desc: to discover ExpressLRS devices on your Wi-Fi network.
en.privacy.perm_files_desc: only when you choose to save firmware or the ExpressLRS Lua script, or pick a firmware file on the device configuration page.
en.privacy.permissions_location: The App does not use your location, camera, contacts or photos.
en.privacy.website_desc: elrsmobile.com uses Google Analytics to count visits and clicks on app download links. YouTube videos on the homepage load only when you press play, using YouTube's privacy-enhanced mode.
en.privacy.security_desc: Sensitive data is kept in your phone's encrypted secure storage, but no method of electronic storage is completely secure. Use a screen lock or biometrics to protect your phone.
en.privacy.changes_desc: If this policy changes, the new version will be posted on this page with an updated date.
en.privacy.contact_desc: Questions about this policy? Open an issue on {github} or ask in the {discord}.

es.how.title: Cómo funciona
es.how.subtitle: Descarga una vez en casa. Flashea en cualquier lugar, no se necesita señal.
es.how.step1_body: Abre el Gestor de Firmware mientras tengas internet y descarga las versiones de ExpressLRS que utilices. Se guardan en tu teléfono para flashear sin conexión.
es.how.step2_body: Enciende tu receptor o transmisor y espera su punto de acceso Wi-Fi, luego únete a la red ExpressLRS RX o TX. La aplicación encuentra el dispositivo automáticamente.

es.features.title: Todo lo que necesitas en el campo

es.features.cache_body: Descarga las versiones de ExpressLRS con antelación y ve cuáles están listas para usar sin conexión. Elige cuántas versiones mantener y cuánto almacenamiento ocupan.
es.features.profiles_body: Guarda frases de enlace, credenciales de Wi-Fi doméstico y dominios regulatorios una vez. Los perfiles de flasheo nombrados te permiten cambiar entre aeronaves y radios con un solo toque.

zh.why.problem_fix_desc: 打开应用，选择您的缓存目标，然后通过 Wi-Fi 刷写。不到 60 秒即可再次升空——无需信号。
zh.why.updates_desc: 更改了您的家庭 Wi-Fi 密码或 SSID？仅仅为了更新一个文本字符串，就将十架飞行器带到您的电脑前，这是一项繁重的任务。
zh.why.updates_fix_desc: 将您的手机带到机队。连接到每个四轴飞行器的 AP，原生并即时更新网络设置或绑定短语。
